description: This Java source file defines the MacroCommonRenderer class, which provides utility methods for rendering and handling widget macros in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating AJAX parameters from update areas, building parameter strings, and resolving link URLs based on context and link types.

classes.name: MacroCommonRenderer
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to assist with rendering macros, AJAX parameter generation, and URL resolution within the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: createAjaxParamsFromUpdateAreas
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript CSV string representing AJAX update areas from a list of UpdateArea objects, incorporating extra parameters, and expanding with locale-specific strings.

methods.name: buildParamStringFromMap
methods.description: Converts a map of parameters into a URL-encoded query string.

methods.name: getLinkUrl
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URL associated with a link object based on its type and execution context, supporting update-area, hidden-form, and default link types.
